title: PIXEL CONTAINER SHAPES
why: The 86e critic found plain boxes and weak opened silhouettes. Bake crate slats, locker vents, safe doors, cache braces and raised lids by kind. Calm the idle red barrel palette while keeping its hazard mark and pulse.
now: Pixel containers have clearer shapes and opened states.
